rule_metadata: Semgrep formatted-sql-query: detects f-string, percent or str.format SQL passed directly or via a variable into DB.execute. Use parameterized queries.

llm.prompt_extra: Context: the scanner is Semgrep with the pattern rule formatted-sql-query. The rule reports a string built with an f-string, the % operator, str.format or concatenation that is passed to a database execute call, directly or through a variable. A verdict of clean means the rule no longer reports a finding. A candidate is built by adding one operator at a time, and an operator can be added only if it comes later than the last one added in this fixed order: rename, format_swap, literal_slice, dead_padding, extract_1, char_launder, deep_nest, db_roundtrip, queue_roundtrip. When no operator is available the search restarts from the original program.
